entries.name: transaction-gate-placeholder-out-of-store-reject#0
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is 08 02 73 05: the body is ConstantPlaceholder(5) and the tree has no constants, so ConstantStore.get(5) indexes past the empty store (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException). deserializeErgoTree degrades a size-flagged tree only on a ValidationException (ErgoTreeSerializer.scala:197), so the JVM rejects. An impl that degrades any body failure round-trips it: the over-accept.

entries.name: transaction-gate-placeholder-in-store-accept#1
entries.description: The twin: A transaction output whose size-flagged, segregated v0 tree 18 05 01 08 d3 73 00 has constant 0 = SigmaProp(true) and the body ConstantPlaceholder(0). It parses. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-type-code-zero-reject#2
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is 08 01 00: a constant of type code 0. TypeSerializer throws InvalidTypePrefix, a SerializerException, which does not degrade the tree: the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-sigmaboolean-opcode-reject#3
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is 08 02 08 01: a SigmaProp constant whose SigmaBoolean opcode is 0x01. The SigmaBoolean parser matches the opcode with no default case: a MatchError, and the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-sigmaprop-control-accept#4
entries.description: The control for #2 and #3: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is 08 02 08 d3, SigmaProp(true). It parses. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-bigint-size-33-reject#5
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is a BigInt constant of declared size 33 (06 21), followed by 33 value bytes: 00 01 and 31 zeros, 2^248, which fits 256 bits. So an impl without the size bound parses it whole. CoreDataSerializer throws a SerializerException for any size over 32: the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-bigint-size-32-degrade-accept#6
entries.description: The twin: A transaction output whose tree holds the same value in 32 bytes (06 20 01, then 31 zeros). It parses, but the root is a BigInt: rule 1001 (CheckDeserializedScriptIsSigmaProp), a ValidationException, degrades the tree, so the object is accepted. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-valdef-id-overflow-reject#7
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is BlockValue(ValDef(2^31, SigmaProp(true)), ValUse(2^31)). ValDefSerializer reads the id with getUIntExact, which throws ArithmeticException (Int overflow) past Int.MaxValue: the JVM rejects. An impl that reads ids as u32 parses the whole tree (the ValUse names the same id): the over-accept.

entries.name: transaction-gate-valdef-id-int-max-accept#8
entries.description: The twin: A transaction output whose tree is the same with id 2^31 - 1 (ff ff ff ff 07), which fits. It parses. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-fundef-negative-tpe-count-reject#9
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree is BlockValue(FunDef(1, ...), ValUse(1)) with the FunDef (d7) type-argument count 0xff, the signed byte -1. safeNewArray(-1) throws NegativeArraySizeException: the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-fundef-tpe-arg-not-typevar-reject#10
entries.description: A transaction output whose tree is the same FunDef with one type argument, Int (04), which is not a type variable. The cast to STypeVar throws ClassCastException: the JVM rejects. An impl that takes any type there parses the tree.

entries.name: transaction-gate-fundef-tpe-arg-typevar-accept#11
entries.description: The twin for #9 and #10: A transaction output whose FunDef has one type argument, the type variable T (67 01 54). It parses. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-sfunc-tpe-param-not-typevar-reject#12
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged, segregated v3 tree (header 1b) has a constant typed SFunc(Int => Int) with one type parameter, Int (70 01 04 04 01 04). TypeSerializer's require(ident.isInstanceOf[STypeVar]) throws IllegalArgumentException, and deserializeErgoTree rethrows it as a SerializerException (with the message 'Tree version (3) is above activated script version (3)'): the JVM rejects. An impl that takes any type as the parameter degrades the tree on the function's data (rule 1009) instead.

entries.name: transaction-gate-sfunc-tpe-param-typevar-degrade-accept#13
entries.description: The twin: A transaction output whose type parameter is T (67 01 54). The type parses and the function's data cannot (rule 1009, a ValidationException), so the tree degrades and the object is accepted. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-box-const-height-overflow-reject#14
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged, segregated v0 tree has constant 0 = a Box (type 63), constant 1 = SigmaProp(true) and the body ConstantPlaceholder(1). The nested box is created at height 2^31, and ErgoBoxCandidate's parse reads the height with getUIntExact (ErgoBoxCandidate.scala:195): ArithmeticException, and the JVM rejects. An impl that reads it as u32 parses the tree.

entries.name: transaction-gate-box-const-height-int-max-accept#15
entries.description: The twin: A transaction output whose nested box is created at height 2^31 - 1. The tree parses. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: transaction-gate-box-const-register-not-constant-reject#16
entries.description: A transaction output whose tree has the same Box constant, created at height 1, with R4 = Height (a3), an expression and not a constant. ErgoBoxCandidate's parse casts each register to EvaluatedValue (ErgoBoxCandidate.scala:231): ClassCastException, and the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-box-const-seven-registers-reject#17
entries.description: A transaction output whose nested box has 7 registers (Int 1 each). There are 6 non-mandatory register ids, R4 to R9, so looking up the seventh (ErgoBoxCandidate.scala:230) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: the JVM rejects.

entries.name: transaction-gate-box-const-six-registers-accept#18
entries.description: The twin for #16 and #17: A transaction output whose nested box has 6 registers, R4 to R9 = Int 1. The tree parses. Round-trip identity.
